title: Initialization Across Units
prompt: A file-scope `int stage = 1;` is already in your editor. Implement `int advance(void)` (returns the old stage, then increments it) and `int current_stage(void)`. The test program below links as one unit, but your functions model what cross-object globals do: file-scope state lives once, and every caller sees the same object — simulate and confirm.

tests.name: shared state advances
tests.hint: Each call reads and writes the same file-scope object — exactly what two objects linked against one definition share.
